$comment:
Shared style-lane composite-member case table. Byte-identical copies live in
openbindings-go/formats/openapi/testdata, openapi-client/go/testdata,
openapi-client/typescript/src/testdata and
openbindings-ts/packages/openapi/src/testdata. Each cell pins the ADMISSION
decision all four engines must reach for one style-lane declaration.

expect is "admitted" or "refused". Every engine asserts it. The two
openapi-client engines additionally assert member, which is the offending
member the shipped predicate names: for a parameter cell the full
"<parameter><path>", for a body cell the "<path>" alone, where a path is
"[]" for an array's items and ".<name>" for an object's property.

The parameter is always named "filter" and the body property always "field".
basis records the authority the cell rests on, read at the pinned bytes
recorded in corpus-lab/OPENAPI-RUNTIME-INDEX.md.

Package: design/openapi-style-lane-composite-member-ruling.md, RULED
2026-08-18. Record: corpus-lab/openapi-runtime/70-*.md.

cases.name: deepObject object with scalar members only
cases.basis: OAS 3.0.3 4.7.12.3 deepObject row; every declared member is a scalar, which the row's own worked example shows.

cases.name: deepObject object with an object member
cases.basis: OAS 3.0.3 4.7.12.3 governs deepObject and defines no representation for an object property.

cases.name: deepObject object with an array member
cases.basis: OAS 3.0.0 4.7.12.3 governs deepObject and defines no representation for an array property.

cases.name: deepObject object with an array-of-objects member
cases.basis: OAS 3.1.0 4.8.12.3 carries the same undefined-representation deepObject row as the 3.0 line.

cases.name: deepObject object with an object member, edition that states it
cases.basis: OAS 3.1.2 4.8.12.3: "The representation of array or object properties is not defined."

cases.name: deepObject object with an object member, 3.0.4
cases.basis: OAS 3.0.4 4.7.12.3 states the same sentence as the 3.1.1 and 3.1.2 rows.

cases.name: deepObject object declaring no members at all
cases.basis: A bare object declares no member kind. Its runtime members may all be scalars, so a declaration-keyed refusal must not reach it.

cases.name: deepObject object with a typeless member
cases.basis: A typeless member is not composite by declaration; its runtime value may be a scalar.

cases.name: deepObject object with a two-branch choice member
cases.basis: Two non-null branches do not collapse, and the declaration admits a scalar value.

cases.name: deepObject object with a nullable-choice object member
cases.basis: Section 9.2's single-non-null-branch collapse: the artifact declared exactly one carriage and it is an object.

cases.name: deepObject object with a union-typed object member on the 3.1 line
cases.basis: Section 5.2 retains every member of a 3.1 type array. The resolved set {object,null} does not declare only object or array because null remains a member.

cases.name: deepObject object with a union-typed object member on the 3.0 line
cases.basis: Every 3.0 edition states "type - Value MUST be a string. Multiple types via an array are not supported", so there is no union declaration to collapse.

cases.name: deepObject object with a two-non-null union member
cases.basis: Section 5.2 retains every member of a 3.1 type array. Every member of {object,array} belongs to the unsupported compound set, so the declaration proves a compound member.

cases.name: deepObject object whose offending member is contributed by allOf
cases.basis: A resolved property schema includes the allOf contributions, which is the family's own notion of resolution.

cases.name: deepObject object with two offending members
cases.basis: Members are visited in code-point order so both engines name the same one.

cases.name: form object with an object member, exploded
cases.basis: The form row cites RFC 6570 Section 3.2.8; RFC 6570 2.4.2 expands each member as a separate variable and its expansions append member strings.

cases.name: form object with an object member, unexploded
cases.basis: The unexploded form expansion joins member names and member string values; a composite member has no string.

cases.name: form array of objects
cases.basis: RFC 6570 3.2.8 appends list members as strings.

cases.name: form array of scalars
cases.basis: A scalar list member has the expansion RFC 6570 3.2.8 defines.

cases.name: form array of arrays
cases.basis: A nested list is a composite member with no expansion.

cases.name: form array with typeless items
cases.basis: Typeless items are not composite by declaration.

cases.name: spaceDelimited array of objects
cases.basis: No accepted edition's style table cites an RFC section for spaceDelimited, and none defines a composite member's representation.

cases.name: spaceDelimited array of scalars
cases.basis: A scalar list member is what the row's own worked example carries.

cases.name: pipeDelimited array of arrays
cases.basis: Same as spaceDelimited: the row governs and defines nothing for a composite member.

cases.name: cookie form object with an array member
cases.basis: A cookie parameter defaults to form style, which is the same lane under the same RFC 6570 citation.

cases.name: path simple object with an object member
cases.basis: OpenBindings OpenAPI 3.0 §8.2 applies the compound-member proof to every compound-capable Parameter style, including path simple.

cases.name: header simple array of objects
cases.basis: OpenBindings OpenAPI 3.0 §8.2 applies the compound-member proof to every compound-capable Parameter style, including header simple.

cases.name: content-form query parameter with an object member
cases.basis: A content-form parameter is not on the style lane at all: section 9.1 serializes it per its declared media type.

cases.name: urlencoded style-lane array of objects
cases.basis: An explicit style, explode or allowReserved selects the RFC6570-style lane on every accepted edition (section 9.2).

cases.name: urlencoded content-lane array of objects
cases.basis: With all three fields absent the property takes the CONTENT path, which carries its JSON image and is not this rule's business.

cases.name: urlencoded style-lane object with an object member
cases.basis: An explicit explode alone selects the style lane.

cases.name: urlencoded style-lane object with scalar members
cases.basis: Every declared member is a scalar.

cases.name: multipart style-lane object with an array member
cases.basis: The multipart style lane is the same lane under the same rows.

cases.name: multipart content-lane object with an array member
cases.basis: Without explicit controls the part takes the content path.
